verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਫਨ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਜੋਈ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਨੈ ਦੂਸਰੋ ਨ ਦੇਖੈ ਪਾਵੈ ਕਹੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: sufan charitr chitr joiee dhekhai soiee jaanai dhoosaro na dhekhai paavai kahu kaise jaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: The miracle of a dream is known to the one who has seen it. No one else can see it. Then how can anyone else know about it?

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਲ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਾਤ ਕੀਏ ਸੁਨੀਅਤ ਕਾਨ ਦੀਏ ਬਕਤਾ ਅਉ ਸ੍ਰੋਤਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਾ ਪੈ ਉਨਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: naal bikhai baat ke'ee suneeat kaan dhe'ee bakataa aau srotaa bin kaa pai unamaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: If something is spoken in one end of a tube and the other end is put in one's own ears, then only he alone would know who has said or heard what. No one else can know.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਘੂਲਾ ਕੇ ਮੂਲ ਬਿਖੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਪਾਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਲੀਜੀਐ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਪੀਏ ਮਨ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: paghoolaa ke mool bikhai jaise jal paan keejai leejeeaai jatan kar pe'ee man maaneeaai ||

en.bdb: Just as a lotus flower or any other plant draws water through its roots from the soil, the flower or plant alone knows about the state of its bloom, who drinks according to his desire.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਹਜ ਕਥਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਧਾਨੀਐ ॥੩੦੫॥
verses.translit_en: gur sikh sa(n)dh mile guhaj kathaa binodh giaan dhiaan prem ras bisam bidhaaneeaai ||305||

en.bdb: The event of a Sikh meeting with his Guru and obtaining initiation from him is very wondrous, blissful and mysterious. The description of the knowledge obtained from the True Guru, contemplation on Him, His love and ecstasy is very strange to describe. No one else can know about it. (305)
